name: Article 7, § 2, point a – 17
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: (a) ensure a fair balance as regards the contributions and benefits of the third country participating in the Programme; including its financial contribution, access to Union funding and industrial benefits. Any derogation from the requirement to provide a financial contribution shall be duly justified, proportionate and limited in time and shall not reduce the financial resources available to entities established in Member States. Participation by associated third countries should be based on reciprocity and should not reduce funding opportunities for undertakings established in Member States.
